messages:
Maya: Quick proposal 1: host a 45m webinar \'Cost vs Latency: Practical Choices for Production Inference\' on Wed Jul 2 10:00 PT. Target: infra/platform + ML teams; goal: generate Dedicated & Optimize leads. Need speakers, run-of-show, and rehearsal slots.

Alex: Sounds good. I can cover product framing + a short roadmap (8-10m).

Sam: Ill do a demo: live batching + cache effectiveness + fallback quantized model. Need 20m and a staging pod reserved.

Priya: Customer segment: FinServ customer open to a 6-8m case study. Legal is reviewing. If approved, they'd join live.

Jordan: For registration: add \'deployment interest\' field (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and utm params for paid social. Route Dedicated leads to AE queue. Also need speaker bios + headshots.

Maya: Draft run-of-show: 10:00 - 10:05 Welcome + goals (Maya)
10:05 - 10:15 Product framing (Alex)
10:15 - 10:35 Live demo (Sam)
10:35 - 10:43 Customer story (Priya + FinServ)
10:43 - 10:55 Q&A (panel)
10:55 - 11:00 CTA + close (Maya)

Alex: Keep demo tight. If customer needs more time, trim Q&A.

Sam: Rehearsal needs: warm KV cache, synthetic load, fallback model available, recording test. Can we do full dress on Jul 1?

Maya: Proposed rehearsals: tech check 30m before live, full dress Jul 1 09:00 PT. Everyone on panel must attend.

Jordan: Promo timeline: 2w email + blog, 1w ads + social, 2d reminder. I'll draft copy and share by Fri.

Priya: I'll confirm customer participation and slide by Tue. Legal said theyll respond in 48h.

CalendarBot: Event created: "Cost vs Latency: Practical Choices for Production Inference" 026-07-02 17:00 UTC / 10:00 PT.

Maya: AV checklist: mics, screen-share permissions, spotlight config, backup presenter, captions, recording. Add fallback broadcast link if Zoom fails.

Jordan: Also capture account_owner as hidden reg field for direct AE routing.

Maya: Actions: Alex = deck + TL;DR slide; Sam = reserve pod + demo checklist; Priya = customer sign-off + slide; Jordan = reg form + promo calendar; Maya = landing + emails + schedule rehearsals.

Sam: :thumbsup: Posting rehearsal checklist in #eng-runtime today.

Priya: Will update when legal clears FinServ.

Maya: Great, I'll book the rehearsal invite and share the draft landing page for review.

CalendarBot: Rehearsal event created: Jul 1 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PT 1 "Webinar Dress Rehearsal: Cost vs Latency". Attendees: Maya, Alex, Sam, Priya, Jordan.

Alex: I'll start the deck and ping for reviews.

Maya: Thanks all will follow up with invites and assets.
